Context: 19. Stipend and training expenses not to be recovered when relieved to take up new appointment

3. These orders cover all aspects of training, including apprenticeship. The exemption from recovery of expenses applies to all types of expenditure including payments made as Training Allowance
- direct and indirect and stipend.
